title: Charter Installation of Interact Club MPS Shaurya

photo.alt: Charter Installation of Interact Club MPS Shaurya

summary: RCMSEP successfully accomplished another Charter Installation of the Interact Club MPS Shaurya on 12th October, 2026 .
description:
RCMSEP successfully accomplished another Charter Installation of the Interact Club MPS Shaurya on 12th October, 2026 . The event was held in the school premises with Chief Guest Rtn Samapati Patel from the RC of Bombay West who holds a position in the Avenue for Youth.
The Interact President Shristi Singh from grade 8, spoke about the various projects they plan to do in the year. The students looked strong and determined and willing to take up projects for the community. The event was led by Rtn. Monica Menon.
I thank Aarti for the wonderful speech in Marathi, Satinderpal for his talk about Interact and Sunita Sharma for her overall motivational speech. RCMSEP highly appreciates the presence of Sunita S, Sunita B, Aarti, Kiran, Swati, Monica, Pal, Jotinder & Naresh.
The event ended with lots of ideas which the Principal has given us. Sunita Bedi will be placing an e-waste bin today, which will be the beginning of a first
project . Proud to be working with such Nation Builders.
